js.home: const cate=env.get("category");const page=env.get("page");if(cate=="/"){const $=utils_1.kitty.load(await(0,utils_1.req)(env.baseUrl));const hot=$(".hot-list .item").toArray().map(item=>{const a=$(item).find("a");return{id:a.attr("href"),title:a.attr("title"),cover:a.find("img").attr("src"),remark:$(item).find(".score").text()}});return{type:"complex",data:[{type:"markdown",extra:{markdown:`\n> 爱看影视 | 高清免费在线观看\n`}},{type:"list",title:"热门推荐",videos:hot}]}}const urlMap={"movie":"/movie/page/${page}.html","tv":"/tv/page/${page}.html","variety":"/variety/page/${page}.html","anime":"/anime/page/${page}.html","krjp":"/krjp/page/${page}.html","us":"/us/page/${page}.html","hk":"/hk/page/${page}.html"};const url=`${env.baseUrl}${urlMap[cate]}`;const $=utils_1.kitty.load(await(0,utils_1.req)(url));return $(".vod-list .item").toArray().map(item=>{const a=$(item).find("a");return{id:a.attr("href"),title:a.attr("title"),cover:a.find("img").attr("src"),remark:$(item).find(".update-info").text()}})
js.detail: const id=env.get("movieId");const url=`${env.baseUrl}${id}`;const $=utils_1.kitty.load(await(0,utils_1.req)(url));const desc=$(".vod-desc").text().trim()||"暂无简介";const tabs=$(".play-tabs li").toArray().map(item=>$(item).text().trim());const playLists=$(".play-list").toArray().map(list=>{return $(list).find("a").toArray().map(item=>{return{id:$(item).attr("href"),text:$(item).text().trim()}})});const playlist=tabs.map((title,i)=>({title,videos:playLists[i]}));return{desc,playlist}
